Hi Sophie — thanks for the detailed notes and attachments. I'm sorry this is blocking your PO. Quick read of the trace looks like RelayState is larger than we expect for the signed POST/Redirect flow which can trip some proxies (we've seen nginx buffer limits cause 400s).

A couple quick asks while we triage: 
- Can you confirm whether the activation link is a GET with a long query string or a SAML POST? (Your trace suggests a large state value in the query string.)
- If you can, try the same link in an incognito window or from a different network to rule out cookie/session interference.

I'll open an internal ticket with our Identity/edge team right now and loop Ben (edge infra) and Monica (onboarding/CS) — Ben, can you check proxy buffer limits and any recent config changes on the Workday backend?

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben to confirm whether the edge is returning 400 for oversized RelayState and whether we can temporarily increase buffer sizes.
2) If edge change is risky, we can instead implement a short-lived server-side state id so RelayState becomes a short token instead of a ~5KB payload.
3) Schedule a 30-min call with AcuTherm and our infra team — Sophie, what windows work for you? We're available 11/24 morning or 11/25 early afternoon PST.

I'll update the ticket and include the saml trace.

Thanks for flagging, Rishi. I pulled the attached trace (thanks Sophie) and did a quick edge capture. Summary: the RelayState being emitted by Workday is ~4.8KB in the query string for the GET handoff. Our TLS/offload reverse proxy (nginx) defaults to a small header and buffer size in the proxy_request/large_client_header_buffers area; when RelayState + query pushes past the buffer threshold we see a 400 and the connection is dropped.

Two pragmatic fixes:
1) Short-term (fastest, low-risk): bump nginx large_client_header_buffers and proxy_buffer_size on the Workday route to accept larger query payloads. I'll prepare a small patch we can roll to edge (attached: nginx-proxy-patch.diff). This is low impact and reversible but requires a short maintenance window (no app change).

2) Medium-term (recommended): change the activation flow to avoid large RelayState in the URL. Options: a) switch the binding to SAML POST so the browser posts state in the body, or b) store serialized state server-side and pass a short token (e.g., state_id=abc123) in the URL — Workday supports a server-side callback pattern in our integration. That avoids fragility across proxies and CDNs.

If Sophie is OK with the temporary nginx adjustment we can schedule a 10-minute edge config push during your preferred window. I also included a small nb: the current Workday link contains our campaign metadata which increases RelayState size — if AcuTherm can accept a link without the extra query params, it may immediately reduce the payload.

Attachments: nginx-proxy-patch.diff (text, 2.4KB) — patch increases large_client_header_buffers from 4 8k to 4 16k and proxy_buffer_size to 16k for the /workday/* vhost.

Proposed slots: 11/24 11:00–11:30 PST or 11/25 13:00–13:30 PST. Sophie — please confirm which you prefer and whether you want our engineers on the same call.
